Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is a distinguished chemical company strategically located at 363 East 42nd Street in the heart of New York City, NY 10017. As a prominent player in the global chemical industry, Standardpharm has established itself as a reliable supplier of high-quality chemical compounds, pharmaceutical intermediates, and specialty chemicals to diverse markets worldwide.

Founded with a commitment to excellence and innovation, Standardpharm Co., Ltd. leverages its prime Manhattan location to serve both domestic and international clients efficiently. The company specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of a comprehensive range of chemical products that meet the stringent requirements of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, research, and industrial applications.

With a strong focus on quality assurance and regulatory compliance, Standardpharm maintains rigorous standards throughout its operations, ensuring that all products meet or exceed industry specifications. The company's experienced team of chemists and technical professionals work diligently to provide customized solutions tailored to specific client needs, from small-scale research quantities to large-scale commercial production.

Standardpharm's strategic position in New York City enables direct access to major transportation hubs, facilitating swift and reliable delivery services globally. The company prides itself on building long-term partnerships with clients through exceptional customer service, competitive pricing, and consistent product quality, making it a trusted name in the chemical supply industry.
